$comment: Deployment configuration. Everything here is optional — anything omitted
falls back to DEFAULT_CONFIG in appConfig.ts, so a fresh clone runs as-is.
Set 'branding.theme.brand' to your brand colour and the whole 100-950 ramp
is derived from it in OKLCH at fixed lightness steps, which keeps contrast
predictable whatever the hue. Use 'brandRamp' only if a brand guideline
Drop logo files in public/assets/ and point 'logo.onDark' / 'logo.onLight'
at them. Leave them null and the app renders 'logo.wordmark' as text.
Sign-in: a method left disabled is hidden, not greyed out. Entra and LDAP
also need server-side settings (tenant, client ID and secret, or the
domain controller) — those never appear in this file, which is served
